owner_split.agent_team: Owns app/agents: prompts, graphs, role schemas and tools. Backend does not replace these files.
owner_split.backend: Owns API, durable extraction jobs, owner/revision checks, Gmail evidence retrieval and transactional completion.

exports.run_extraction: Synchronous callable: keyword settings, scope. Returns ExtractionOutcome-compatible dict or model.

backend_tools.stage: stage(case_id, expected_revision, result); fields/value/evidence schema is ExtractionResult; validates but does not persist

rules: Do not execute roles 2-5, send mail or directly persist results in this adapter.
Use backend scope for owner, batch and revision; do not trust model-supplied identity.
Enforce remaining_seconds before every model/tool turn and bounded provider timeouts; disable tracing of payloads.
Successful extraction must stage evidence-backed ExtractionResult; worker revalidates identity and derives missing-item state before transactional commit.
ON_HOLD stages nothing for persistence; FAILED/STALE cannot become success.
Missing or incompatible adapter hides START, rejects start with 503 AGENT_INTEGRATION_REQUIRED, and stops extraction-worker startup before processing jobs.
current_status: Adapter deliberately not implemented here. Agent PR25 integration and real end-to-end test remain required.
